string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: New top bar, the Island: while you browse, a pill in the center shows the time and temperature
The pill grows with what is happening: no internet, timer, alarm in the next 12 h, what is playing, birthday, your team\'s game, list expiring
The left corner shows one line about the category: what is on air in Watch, the last radio or podcast in Listen, controllers and crew in Play
The corner never repeats: it hides when its item is selected or when the pill already says the same
▲ opens the usual bar with a dark veil behind it; when the TV turns on it stays open for 4 seconds
The other bars are still in Settings › Home screen › Top bar
Icon animation adapts to the device: strong devices animate everything; mid ones animate the selected icon and the categories once on arrival; if frames get heavy, it steps down by itself
Radio and Podcasts: button icons show again, and episodes show the podcast cover

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: On HOME, browsing the cross, is there a pill at the top center with an orange dot, the time and the temperature?
With a radio playing (or a timer running), does the pill grow and show what it is?
In Watch, with an item other than TV selected, does the left corner show what is on air?
With ▲ at the top of the cross, does the usual bar appear with the dark veil and the pill hide?
Idle on HOME, do the category icons play once and rest, without the screen feeling heavy?
